messages:
Zoe Park: Pushed the 'Penumbra' dark theme file. Main asks: editor token legibility at 13px, multi-line chart swatches, and table row visibility on compact lists. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxxx/penumbra
Miguel Santos: Loving the mood. Quick nit: link color and keyword are almost identical in the editor. Hard to scan logs.
Priya Singh: Agreed. Also small-multiples need swatches that stay distinct at 10px. Think about luminance parity, not just hue.
Evan Lowe: Proposed token map: keyword #4EB5FF, type #BEEAFF, string #A0E5A0, number #FFB46E, fn-name #FFD9A0, comment #6E747A. Move links to amber #FFC86B to separate from keywords.
DesignBot: Contrast scan (Penumbra v0.2): header (15px/600) = 4.7:1, body (13px/400) = 4.12:1, inline code = 3.6:1. Recommendation: darken code background by 5% or boost inline-code weight.
Miguel Santos: I'd rather keep body text and adjust tokens/background. Small change: pre/code bg rgba(10,12,14,0.70) and border rgba(255,255,255,0.03).
Priya Singh: Chart palette draft (6-col, colorblind-safe): #FF6A5C, #4BC8C2, #556BFF, #FFC86B, #9E8EFF, #2F8E5B. Run grayscale test. Legends 12px semibold, swatches 10px.
Accessibility: Grayscale test flagged coral (#FF6A5C) vs amber (#FFC86B) low separation. Suggest swap amber to #FFD86B (higher luminance) or darken coral slightly.
Evan Lowe: OK swap amber -> #FFD86B for better greyscale separation. Also increase table divider alpha to 0.14 so rows read in dense lists.
Zoe Park: Copy tweak: call the option 'Penumbra (Dark)' in the theme menu so customers see the variant name. Also add a tiny accessibility chip next to the theme toggle with AA/WCAG status.
Miguel Santos: UX nit: chart point hover currently adds a big glow. Please switch to subtle outline + 1.05 scale. Less noisy on dashboards.
DesignBot: Noted. Re-run contrast + colorblind sims after Figma update. Staging preview URL: https://staging.redwood.ai/theme-preview/penumbra. Ping me when file updated. :eyes:
